project: WSR-001 Worker Opening Record Identifies the Execution
description: Implement WSR-001 so every Worker event topic begins with an authoritative SESSION/STARTED record containing stable session, Factory, provider-selection, timing, Work, and attempt correlation before provider output, with synthesized lifecycle provenance and valid opening-to-terminal history even when no Provider Session reference exists.

context.customerAsk: Make SESSION/STARTED the first record on every Worker topic with stable session, provider-selection, timing, attempt, and Factory correlation before provider output; declare synthesized lifecycle provenance; and preserve valid opening and terminal history for providers with no Provider Session reference. Provide WSR-FT-001, WSR-FT-002, WSR-FT-003 plus focused unit, provider conformance, and Events ordering evidence.
context.problem: Worker history does not yet guarantee that the first record carries every authoritative correlation and provenance fact needed to identify the execution. Provider identity may become observable too late, and consumers can incorrectly depend on an optional provider-native session reference, making live and replayed timelines ambiguous across providers.
context.solution: Extend the provider-neutral Worker lifecycle contract and canonical Worker Sessions invocation path so an injected-clock timestamp and all known execution correlation are published in SESSION/STARTED at topic position 1. Bind actual provider identity before provider-authored output, retain optional Provider Session references without inference, and prove stable live/replay behavior across streaming, session-bearing, final-only, and no-session-reference providers without implementing later recording-persistence stories.

acceptanceCriteria: Every exercised Worker path publishes exactly one SESSION/STARTED as topic position 1 before provider-authored output and finishes with a legal terminal lifecycle record.
The opening exposes every known WSR lifecycle field while genuinely unknown optional facts remain absent rather than zero-filled, defaulted, or inferred.

Live and replay observations preserve the exact opening startedAt and known Worker, Factory, dispatch, turn, Work, and attempt identities, and lifecycle provenance is SYNTHESIZED, notification-shaped, and LIFECYCLE_ONLY.
Actual provider identity is present in the opening or established by a preceding provider-binding SESSION/UPDATED, so no provider-authored event is observable first.

Streaming, session-bearing, final-only, and no-Provider-Session-reference executions retain legal provider-neutral ordering, honest fidelity, and inspectable opening-to-terminal history, demonstrated by WSR-FT-001, WSR-FT-002, WSR-FT-003 and focused unit, conformance, and ordering tests.
Implementation respects service ownership and the single Events publication path, introduces no recording persistence barrier or dual write, and includes no broad unrelated cleanup.
Typecheck passes and tests pass; no NEW lint violations relative to current main, and the gates green on main (backend-size, pkg-maint, pkg-file-count, pkg-structure, vet) stay green.

The implementation/review loop continues until required CI is terminal and passing, all blocking PR conversation feedback is explicitly addressed, merge conflicts and shared/generated-file churn are resolved against current main, and the PR is actually merged.

userStories.title: Publish a stable, correlated opening record
userStories.description: As a customer inspecting a Worker Session, I want its first event to state which execution began and when so that I can interpret the stream without relying on later output.
acceptanceCriteria: Each Worker Session topic begins at position 1 with exactly one SESSION/STARTED, committed before provider handoff or provider-authored output.

The opening includes status, injected-clock startedAt, workerSessionId, and every known Factory Session, recording, dispatch, turn, Work, attempt, continuation, provider-selection, model, and capabilities value supplied through the canonical invocation path.
attemptReason uses INITIAL, RETRY, or RESUME as appropriate, and known correlation is preserved through the Petri and JavaScript paths that share Worker Sessions invocation.
Unknown optional metadata remains absent and is not replaced with zero values, empty provider facts, or reconstructed Provider Session data.
The opening timestamp and known Worker, Factory, dispatch, turn, Work, and attempt identities are identical in live observation and replay projection, covering WSR-FT-002.
Focused Worker Sessions unit and projection/replay tests pass.
Typecheck passes.
Tests pass.
userStories.notes: Opening SESSION/STARTED now carries the injected-clock timestamp, stable Worker/Factory/recording/dispatch/turn/Work/attempt correlations, explicit provider/model/capability selections, and exact continuation metadata when supplied. Unknown optionals remain omitted. Runtime dispatch planning and JavaScript invocation both preserve the new request facts, and focused live/replay plus omission tests pass.

userStories.title: Establish lifecycle provenance and provider-before-output ordering
userStories.description: As a customer reading a Worker timeline, I want to distinguish system-authored lifecycle facts from provider output and know the selected provider before its output so that provenance and attribution are unambiguous.
acceptanceCriteria: Worker Sessions-owned opening and terminal lifecycle records declare DeliverySynthesized, RepresentationNotification, and FidelityLifecycleOnly without claiming provider-native authorship or fidelity.
The actual provider is present in SESSION/STARTED whenever resolved at opening.

When actual provider resolution genuinely occurs after opening, the first provider-bound record is SESSION/UPDATED and establishes actual provider identity before every dependent provider-authored event.
Events ordering integration evidence rejects provider output before the opening or required provider binding and proves the legal opening/provider-output/terminal sequence under streaming execution.

WSR-FT-001 proves opening-first, provider-identity-before-output, exactly-once live records in finalized history, and terminal-last behavior without adding a Worker Sessions-to-Recordings payload write.
Focused Worker Sessions unit and Events ordering integration tests pass.
Typecheck passes.
Tests pass.
userStories.notes: Worker Sessions now stamps opening and terminal drafts with synthesized notification/lifecycle-only provenance and carries the resolved provider on the opening when known. The provider-output bridge resolves attempt dispatches to stable Worker Session topics, publishes canonical drafts through the same Events path, and emits one SESSION/UPDATED provider binding when provider identity is first learned after opening. Focused publisher and real in-memory Events tests prove pre-opening rejection, opening/binding/output/terminal ordering, exactly-once binding, terminal-last history, and one downstream forwarding; Worker Sessions tests, factory-runtime tests, race tests, and vet pass.

userStories.title: Preserve provider-independent opening and terminal history
userStories.description: As a customer using any supported provider, I want a valid Worker lifecycle even when the provider has no native session identifier so that Worker history is not conditional on provider transcript capabilities.
acceptanceCriteria: A provider that emits no providers.SessionRef still yields an inspectable SESSION/STARTED, normalized provider output when available, and a legal terminal lifecycle record; the reference remains absent rather than synthesized.
Shared provider conformance covers representative Claude tool lifecycle, Codex streaming, Cursor/ACP session-bearing, and Agy final-only fixtures through production registrations.
Each representative provider produces legal provider-neutral Kind/Phase pairs, actual provider provenance on provider-authored drafts, correct source-event idempotency, and terminal behavior.

Streaming providers report their actual delivery and fidelity, while final-only providers expose only minimal synthesized lifecycle plus final authoritative output and do not fabricate streaming capability.
WSR-FT-003 proves the same legal normalized protocol and honest fidelity across providers without requiring a provider-specific transcript reader for opening-to-terminal replay.

Functional evidence uses root.BuildProcess and Process.Execute, production registrations, ProviderCommandRunner with sanitized recorded fixtures, and deterministic event or terminal synchronization rather than Mock Workers or arbitrary sleeps.
Typecheck passes.
Tests pass.
